These queries come from the documentation page alone and none has been run, so the less certain steps are guesses. Those are `sum` of an empty vector, `at 3` on a vector, `split` of an empty string, and string keys in `groupBy`.

R1: filter ~(if (/active) ~(at :address | coalesce {} | at :city | coalesce "" | lower | eq "berlin") ~(false)) * /name | sort ~(/)
R2: * (at :age) | filter ~(type | eq ::number) | avg | round 2
R3: filter ~(/status | eq "paid") | groupBy ~(/customer) * (* /items | flat | * (mul /qty /price) | sum | round 2)
R4: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | groupBy ~(at :assignee | if (eq null) ~("unassigned") ~(/login)) * count
R5: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | sort ~([(/comments | desc) /number]) | take 3 * /number
R6: [/dependencies /devDependencies] * entries | flat | filter ~(/1 | startsWith "^") * (/0 | keyword) | distinct | sort ~(/)
R7: lines | filter ~(count | gt 0) * (split " ") | filter ~(/3 | parseJson | gte 500) * /2 | distinct | sort ~(/)
R8: lines | filter ~(count | gt 0) * (split " ") | filter ~(/1 | eq "GET") * (/4 | split "ms" | first | parseJson) | avg | round 0
R9: lines | filter ~(count | gt 0) | drop 1 * (split ",") | filter ~(/2 | ne "") | groupBy ~(/1) * (* (/2 | parseJson) | avg | round 1)
R10: lines | filter ~(count | gt 0) | drop 1 * (split "," | at 3 | coalesce "" | split ";") | flat | filter ~(count | gt 0) * lower | distinct | sort ~(/)
R11: lines * trim | filter ~(count | gt 0) | filter ~(startsWith "#" | not) | filter ~(split "=" | /0 | trim | startsWith "DB_") * (split "=" | [(/0 | trim | drop 3 | lower | keyword) (drop 1 | join "=" | trim)]) | tag ::map
R12: /services | entries | filter ~(/1 | at :enabled | eq true) * {:name (/0 | keyword) :url (/1 | [/protocol "://" /host ":" (at :port | coalesce 80 | print)] | join "")} | sort ~(/name)
R13: {:total (filter ~(/type | eq "purchase") * (at :meta | coalesce {} | at :amount | coalesce 0) | sum | round 2) :users (filter ~(/type | eq "purchase") * /user | distinct | count) :hasRefund (any ~(/type | lower | eq "refund"))}
R14: ["Apple","banana","apple","Cherry","BANANA","date","Elder","cherry","fig","Apple"] * lower | groupBy ~(/) | entries | filter ~(/1 | count | gt 1) * (/0 | keyword) | sort ~(/)
